Axillary involvement in Hallopeau-type pemphigus vegetans ... involving both axillary folds

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Clinical photograph of a human patient showing exuberant exophytic, papillomatous, erosive vegetating plaques of the left axillary fold, consistent with the captioned and in-text described Hallopeau-type pemphigus vegetans. [raw subtype: Hallopeau-type] B: Clinical photograph of the contralateral axillary fold showing a similar exophytic, papillomatous, erosive vegetating plaque, matching the captioned Hallopeau-type pemphigus vegetans involvement of both axillae. [raw subtype: Hallopeau-type]
panels.attribution_text: Marhraoui et al. Extensive Flexural and Pan-Ungual Involvement in Hallopeau-Type Pemphigus Vegetans: A Case Report.. Cureus 2026. doi:10.7759/cureus.115333. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 1.
panels.figure_caption: Axillary involvement in Hallopeau-type pemphigus vegetans. (A, B) Exuberant exophytic, papillomatous, and erosive vegetating plaques involving both axillary folds.
in_text_mentions: The patient was afebrile and hemodynamically stable. Dermatologic examination revealed multiple large, confluent, exophytic vegetating plaques arising on an erythematous base, with prominent verrucous, papillomatous, cauliflower-like surfaces and moist erosive borders. The lesions predominantly involved both axillae and the pubic region, with additional involvement of the inguinal folds, buttocks, and intergluteal cleft (Figures 1A, 1B). Palmoplantar pustules on an erythematous base and crusted erosions were also present.

source_variant.figure_caption: (A) Well-demarcated hyperkeratotic plaque with an eroded surface. (B) Dermoscopy reveals a white background with surface scale, multiple keratin-filled follicular ostia, white perifollicular circles surrounded by erythema, and white structureless areas. Some red areas attributable to bleeding and/or dense vascularity are seen at the periphery.
